thread:
jordan: quick postmortem follow-up from last night's pager — want to get ownership and dates locked for the alert tuning action items.

jordan: action list (short):
- 1) reduce noisy rule fanout + dedupe window
- 2) tighten thresholds for redis-conn-errors on prod-api
- 3) add quiet-hours suppression for non-critical alerts
- 4) handback owners + update runbook entries

jordan: who can own 1 & 2? i can take 4 (runbook) and coordinate rollout.

priya: i can pick up #1 (fanout/dedupe). plan: increase dedupe window from 60s -> 300s for the noisy family, and add a tag-based dedupe key (region + instance_type).

priya: quick config snippet i'll test in staging:```yaml
alert: redis_conn_errors_high
expr: sum(increase(redis_conn_errors_total[5m])) by (instance, region) > 10
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
  dedupe_key: "{{region}}:{{instance_type}}"
```

simon: sounds good. for #2 (thresholds) i'm concerned about impact on legit incidents — suggest a canary change (apply to eu-prod only for 24h) then roll.
simon: i'll own #2 if priya+me coordinate on the canary.

erica: +1 on canary. also propose adding a fallback route to the paging policy so we don't page on transient bursts — i can file the change and own the policy update.
erica: here's a short playbook line i'll add to runbook: "If paging >3x in 10m for same rule, suppress page and create ticket for oncall team to investigate."

alerts-bot: created Jira ticket ONCALL-342: "Alert noise reduction - redis and fanout dedupe" and linked to postmortem doc https://docs.internal/runs/pm-2026-03-20

jordan: great — ownership so far: #1 priya, #2 simon, #3 erica (quiet-hours), #4 jordan (runbook).
jordan: timelines: priya do staging test by EOD Thu (1719540000), simon deploy canary Fri morning, erica update paging policy Fri afternoon, jordan will update runbook and notify SRE.

priya: ack, will post test results in this thread.
simon: ack, i'll schedule the canary and post the rollout plan.
erica: filing policy PR now, will add reviewers from SRE and oncall.

jordan: thanks all — if anyone hits blockers ping me or use #eng-oncall and tag @jordan. :thumbsup:

priya: small note — can we also add a metric in the dashboard for dedupe-suppressed_pages? helps validate tuning.
jordan: yes please, add to the per-route dashboard and i will include in weekly oncall report.

simon: one more — if canary looks noisy we should auto-backout after 2 hours. adding that to deploy plan.

alerts-bot: reminder set: /remind @eng-oncall to review ONCALL-342 results on 1719626400

erica: done.

jordan: closing loop — i'll post a short TL;DR in the postmortem doc once actions are complete.

priya: thanks, everyone.

simon: thanks :rocket:
